slides.text: Why willpower fails, and what to use instead.
Willpower is a limited resource you spend on decisions all day. By evening it is mostly gone.
So relying on it is a plan that works best exactly when you need it least.
What works better is changing the environment so the right action takes less effort.
Add friction to what you want less of. Phone in another room. Delete the app.
Remove friction from what you want more of. Shoes by the door. Book on the pillow.
You do not need more discipline. You need fewer decisions.
Save this for the next time you blame yourself.
slides.sub: Follow for one small rule daily

caption:
Willpower is a poor foundation. Design your environment so the good choice is the easy one.

Which one small change will you make today?
